lines: Built with: webpack.config.js, package.json declares @nextcloud/webpack-vue-config ^6.0.0, webpack ^5.88.2.
No node_modules in /app, so neither the framework the delivered packages are written against nor their installed versions are known. 84 packages are delivered.
1 delivered file carries no source map, 2 files do. The bytes of the unmapped ones are counted but charged to no package.

8 delivered files look like a webpack or CommonJS bundle. Their internal structure is not derivable from the artefact, so each counts as one file and the chunk figures below say nothing about what is inside them.
4 packages are imported by their root in src, each delivered in fewer than 8 modules, so a per-module import has nothing to leave out and the specifier decides no bytes here.
